summary: Harvestone Low Carbon Partners, LP is one active ECP Fund V and Harvestone Group partnership formed in 2022. The existing ECP owner period already covers the census holding and must not be duplicated; it should be enriched to Fund V, while Harvestone Group should be represented as the separate active co-owner. MAG, Blue Flint, Dakota Spirit, IBEC, Coal Creek and holding/project entities remain subordinate. Bank of America's US$205 million Blue Flint CCS tax equity is project financing, not a platform owner.
